name: guardfall-posix
description: GuardFall classes A-E for the POSIX shell dialect: adversarial inputs that evade a surface-level scanner. Every case must be classified as 'effect present or top' (no silent misses). These mirror the bash set but are analysed with --lang posix (front/bash in the POSIX variant).

cases.note: empty single-quote fragment inside the command name
word splitting via the default IFS
command substitution yielding the program name
command substitution nested inside an argument
encoded payload piped to an interpreter
interpreter invoked with a command string
unbounded loop: the step budget must yield top
C4 adversarial: unbalanced quote; the parse failure must degrade to top, not to a benign miss
C4 adversarial: pipeline of unresolved commands; must degrade to top, not to an empty result
